investigation_notes.Description: The alert flags 315 SharePoint file downloads from Marcus Webb on the Legal_M_A site originating from Tallinn, Estonia at 12:39 local time. The user is a Senior Legal Operations Manager and the downloaded paths (Legal, M&A, Executive) are consistent with their role; the user agent is a modern Chrome browser and there are no recent events or similar alerts. The volume is elevated (~6.3x baseline) but the activity occurred during local business hours from an expected European location and there is no history of night-time or anomalous behavior, so this is assessed as Low Priority.
